answer: The copper holds work receipts rather than names, so the signal of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the crystal of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, split across independent auditors, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
